name: Z-Push Detection Suite
summary: Rejected logins, password spraying from one or many addresses, new devices, remote wipes, attack tools and mail server outages from Z-Push, the ActiveSync gateway, whose log Wazuh does not decode at all.
summary_zh: Z-Push（ActiveSync 閘道）的登入被拒、來自單一或大量位址的密碼噴灑、新裝置、遠端抹除、攻擊工具與郵件伺服器中斷；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼它的記錄。
notes: Wazuh 4.14.7 has no decoder for Z-Push. On two production Z-Push hosts (about 28,000 log lines a day between them) nothing was decoded; the only alerts those hosts raised from web traffic were the built-in POST flood rule 31533 (level 10), 50 to 140 a day on one host, every one of them ordinary phone synchronisation.

Z-Push sits between the phones and the mail server, so the mail server sees the Z-Push host as the client of every ActiveSync session. The Zimbra backend passes the phone's address along (Zimbra logs it first in oip= and as devip= in the user agent, with the last six characters of the device id), but the full device id and the result the phone received are only in the Z-Push log. A lockout or block keyed on the client address at the mail server hits the Z-Push host, which is every phone at once.

Logins come from the request summary Z-Push writes at the end of every request, the only line with the client address, the account, the device and the HTTP result. A rejected ActiveSync login is level 5; eight for one account within five minutes level 10; rejected logins for eight different accounts from one address within ten minutes (password spraying) level 10; twenty rejected logins within ten minutes on one host, each for another account and from another address (spraying from many addresses, as in Microsoft's DEV-0343 report) level 10; a successful login afterwards level 11 for that account and level 12 from the spraying address. Autodiscover logins are counted the same way, separately. Addresses sent as ::ffff:a.b.c.d by a dual-stack web server are decoded as plain IPv4.

Successful logins: ActiveSync authenticates every request, so a phone logs in hundreds of times a day, mostly from public carrier addresses (measured: 117 to 615 successful requests a day from public addresses on two hosts). Each is recorded at level 2 and does not alert. What alerts: the first time this manager sees an account used with a device id, level 3 from a private address and level 5 from a public one (the device id, not the address, because a phone changes carrier address several times a day; requests without a device form one pair per account); a built-in administrator account (admin, administrator, root, postmaster, zimbra) using ActiveSync at all, level 3 from a private address and level 8 from a public one, at most once an hour each; and a success after repeated failures (above). Measured on nine days of two hosts: 6 first-seen alerts on the first day, then 4 in eight days. On a new installation every device in use alerts once. Private means 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10; nothing in the pack names a host, an address or an account of a site.

A phone with an outdated saved password fails exactly like an attacker, for as long as nobody fixes it: the single-account rule then fires once per eight failures. The spraying rule needs different accounts, but Wazuh cannot count distinct values, so two such phones behind one carrier NAT address also reach it (in the sandbox after seven failures each); the many-address rule needs about a dozen failing at the same time. Private and carrier-grade NAT ranges are listed in etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses and raise a separate rule that no active response is attached to. The Zimbra backend answers four refusals that are not a wrong password with the same HTTP 401: an expired auth token, ActiveSync switched off for the account, a failed second factor, and Z-Push missing from zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs (then every login fails). Their request summaries are recorded at level 2 and never counted, so a mail server that stops trusting the Z-Push host cannot make every account look brute-forced or have real users' carrier addresses blocked.

Devices: a new device registered for an account is level 5. Remote wipe: a device with a pending wipe connecting is level 6, the wipe sent to it level 8, the device confirming it level 10. A changed device policy is level 3. Z-Push 2.7 has no device allow or block list; the closest is the ActiveSync switch of a Zimbra account, and a device refused because of it is level 5.

Availability: every request that cannot reach the mail server is recorded; ten in ten minutes on one host is level 7 (at most every 30 minutes), sixty in an hour level 10. A routine mail server restart produced five in two minutes on one host, below the threshold. Zimbra refusing the Z-Push server (not in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs, every login fails) is level 10, its DoSFilter throttling it level 7, a failed second factor (with two-factor authentication a device must use an application code) level 5. Loop detection is level 3 (about eight a day on two hosts), other fatal errors level 3, ten of them in ten minutes level 7.

At the default LOGLEVEL_INFO most of the log is folder exports, message lists and waiting for changes. Those stay at level 0, and the agent group drops them before they leave the host: on one real day 91 per cent of the lines (28,054 to 2,528 on two hosts). What remains is mostly the request summaries, at level 0 unless they follow failures.

Web server access log: phones synchronise in bursts (one tablet sent 55 POSTs in 20 seconds), which the built-in rule 31533 reports as a likely bot at level 10. Rule 132280 stops it counting successful ActiveSync POSTs. A rejected one still alerts through the built-in 400 rule 31101 (level 5), so where the access log is collected a rejected login appears twice. The access log also has the user agent of every request: an ActiveSync or autodiscover POST from a scripting or attack tool (PEAS, pyActiveSync, python-requests, curl, PowerShell, Go and similar) is level 8, and a POST claiming DeviceType iPhone or iPad without an Apple user agent (PEAS defaults to iPhone) level 7. On nine days of two hosts there were four user agents (the monitoring probe and three Apple and Android mail apps) and no mismatch in 16,756 iPhone and iPad POSTs.

PREREQUISITES: LOGLEVEL at least LOGLEVEL_INFO (the default), because the request summary is an informational line. The pack reads the file log (LOGBACKEND filelog, the default) or Z-Push's syslog backend, and also the copy rsyslog makes of the file with imfile. Read z-push.log, not z-push-error.log, which repeats its warnings and errors. Behind a reverse proxy, set USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER in Z-Push, or every address in the log is the proxy's.

Deliberately not done: the LOGAUTHFAIL line of ActiveSync and the fatal exception of a rejected request are recorded but not counted, because the request summary already counts that request; no active response is offered for the single-account rule, whose address is often a phone's carrier NAT address, nor for the many-address rule, where blocking the last address achieves nothing; the line announcing a new device has no address (the request summary that follows it has); a successful request is not graded by its address alone, since that would alert on every request of a phone on mobile data; browser user agents are not graded (spraying kits use them, but so may legitimate apps, and nothing measured them); there is no user agent allow list, because a tool alerts once per account ever; and no rule on the logged Z-Push version, because CVE-2025-8264 (fixed in 2.7.6) needs the IMAP backend with IMAP_FROM_SQL_QUERY, which the log does not show.

Attack tooling in the Z-Push log: the first time this manager sees an account used by a scripting or attack tool (Z-Push logs the user agent before every exception and for every GET, which is how EASSniper tests passwords) is level 6, later requests of the same pair level 2, so a monitoring script or an administrator testing with curl alerts once. A document library search (PEAS probes file shares this way; phones do not) is level 8 with backends that log it (not the Zimbra backend, which accepts the search and returns nothing). A login or account name shaped like an injection (a quote followed by SQL syntax, LDAP filter syntax, "../", "${", a backtick, an HTML tag; CVE-2025-8264 was an SQL injection through the login) is level 8 when the request ends in an error and level 12 when it succeeds; a rejected one stays a counted failed login, so that a junk account name cannot hide password guessing from the brute-force rules. Z-Push does not filter login names, and the decoders read the address and the HTTP result from the end of the line: up to 1.1 an account name could contain from='<any address>' and have that address decoded, and blocked by the active response.

Tested with 147 cases in a Wazuh 4.14.7 sandbox: the routine stream, a mail server restart and the user agents are real lines from Z-Push 2.7.6 with the Zimbra backend (revision 75); rejected logins, refusals, wipes, new devices and the attack tooling are built from the Z-Push 2.7.6, Zimbra backend, PEAS and EASSniper source, since none occurred in the nine days of logs available. wazuh-logtest does not apply ignore=, so the at-most-every-N-minutes limits were not observable there; first-seen pairs were (logtest keeps them per session). The agent group's filters and line joining were checked with the sandbox's own log collector.
notes_zh: Wazuh 4.14.7 沒有 Z-Push 的解碼器。兩台正式的 Z-Push 主機（合計每天約 28,000 行記錄）沒有任何一行被解碼；這兩台因網頁流量產生的告警只有內建的 POST 洪水規則 31533（level 10），其中一台每天 50 到 140 筆，全部都是手機的正常同步。

Z-Push 位於手機與郵件伺服器之間，所以郵件伺服器看到的每個 ActiveSync 連線的用戶端都是 Z-Push 主機。Zimbra 後端會把手機的位址轉送過去（Zimbra 記在 oip= 的第一個位址，以及 user agent 裡的 devip=，另附裝置 ID 的最後六個字元），但完整的裝置 ID 與手機收到的結果只在 Z-Push 的記錄裡。在郵件伺服器上依用戶端位址鎖定或封鎖，擋到的是 Z-Push 主機，也就是所有手機。

登入判斷取自 Z-Push 在每個請求結束時寫的請求摘要，那是唯一同時有用戶端位址、帳號、裝置與 HTTP 結果的一行。ActiveSync 登入被拒為 level 5；同一帳號五分鐘內八次為 level 10；同一位址十分鐘內有八個不同帳號被拒（密碼噴灑）為 level 10；同一主機十分鐘內有二十次被拒、每次都是不同的帳號與不同的位址（從大量位址噴灑，如微軟 DEV-0343 報告所述）為 level 10；之後登入成功，同一帳號為 level 11，來自噴灑位址則為 level 12。autodiscover 的登入以同樣方式另外計算。雙堆疊網頁伺服器以 ::ffff:a.b.c.d 形式送來的位址，會解碼成一般的 IPv4。

成功登入：ActiveSync 每個請求都要驗證，所以一支手機一天會登入數百次，而且大多來自電信的公開位址（實測兩台主機：每天有 117 到 615 個成功請求來自公開位址）。每一次都以 level 2 記錄、不告警。會告警的是：這台 manager 第一次看到某帳號搭配某個裝置 ID，來自私有位址為 level 3、來自公開位址為 level 5（用裝置 ID 而不是位址，因為手機一天會換好幾次電信位址；沒有裝置的請求則每個帳號算一組）；內建的管理者帳號（admin、administrator、root、postmaster、zimbra）用到 ActiveSync，來自私有位址為 level 3、公開位址為 level 8，各自最多每小時一次；以及多次失敗後的成功（見上）。以兩台主機九天的資料實測：第一天 6 筆首次出現的告警，之後八天共 4 筆。全新安裝時，每個使用中的裝置都會告警一次。私有位址指 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7 與 fe80::/10；套件裡沒有任何站台的主機、位址或帳號名稱。

手機存著過期的密碼時，失敗的樣子和攻擊者完全一樣，而且會持續到有人修正為止：單一帳號的規則會每八次失敗觸發一次。噴灑規則需要不同的帳號，但 Wazuh 無法計算不重複的值，所以同一個電信 NAT 位址後面有兩支這樣的手機也會觸發（沙箱實測：各失敗七次後）；大量位址的規則則要大約十來支同時失敗。私有網段與電信級 NAT（CGNAT）網段列在 etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses，觸發的是另一條沒有掛主動回應的規則。Zimbra 後端對四種不是密碼錯誤的拒絕，回的也是同樣的 HTTP 401：auth token 過期、帳號關閉了 ActiveSync、第二因素驗證失敗，以及 Z-Push 不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs（此時所有登入都會失敗）。這些請求的摘要以 level 2 記錄、永不計數，所以郵件伺服器不再信任 Z-Push 主機時，不會讓每個帳號看起來都在被暴力破解，也不會讓真實使用者的電信位址被封鎖。
裝置：帳號註冊了新裝置為 level 5。遠端抹除：有待抹除的裝置連線為 level 6，抹除指令送出為 level 8，裝置回報已抹除為 level 10。裝置原則變更為 level 3。Z-Push 2.7 沒有裝置允許或封鎖清單；最接近的是 Zimbra 帳號的 ActiveSync 開關，因此被拒絕的裝置為 level 5。

可用性：每個連不到郵件伺服器的請求都會記錄；同一主機十分鐘內十次為 level 7（最多每 30 分鐘一次），一小時內六十次為 level 10。一次例行的郵件伺服器重啟在一台主機上兩分鐘內產生五次，低於門檻。Zimbra 拒絕 Z-Push 伺服器（不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs，所有登入都會失敗）為 level 10，被 DoSFilter 節流為 level 7，第二因素驗證失敗（開啟兩步驟驗證後，裝置必須改用應用程式密碼）為 level 5。迴圈偵測為 level 3（兩台主機每天約八筆），其他致命錯誤為 level 3，十分鐘內十次為 level 7。
在預設的 LOGLEVEL_INFO 下，記錄大多是資料夾匯出、郵件清單與等待變更。這些維持 level 0，agent 群組也會在送出主機前就丟掉：以真實的一天計算丟掉 91% 的行數（兩台主機 28,054 行降到 2,528 行）。剩下的大多是請求摘要，除非跟在失敗之後，否則為 level 0。

網頁伺服器存取記錄：手機是一陣一陣地同步（一台平板 20 秒內送了 55 個 POST），內建規則 31533 會把它當成疑似機器人報 level 10。規則 132280 讓它不再計算成功的 ActiveSync POST。被拒絕的請求仍會由內建的 400 規則 31101（level 5）告警，所以有收存取記錄時，一次被拒的登入會出現兩筆。存取記錄也有每個請求的 user agent：來自腳本或攻擊工具（PEAS、pyActiveSync、python-requests、curl、PowerShell、Go 等）的 ActiveSync 或 autodiscover POST 為 level 8；自稱 DeviceType 為 iPhone 或 iPad 卻沒有 Apple user agent 的 POST（PEAS 預設就是 iPhone）為 level 7。兩台主機九天的資料只有四種 user agent（監控探測與三種 Apple、Android 郵件程式），16,756 個 iPhone 與 iPad 的 POST 沒有一個不符。

前提條件：LOGLEVEL 至少為 LOGLEVEL_INFO（預設值），因為請求摘要是資訊等級的一行。套件可讀檔案記錄（LOGBACKEND filelog，預設）或 Z-Push 的 syslog 後端，也可讀 rsyslog 以 imfile 複製的檔案內容。請讀 z-push.log，不要讀 z-push-error.log，後者重複了前者的警告與錯誤。若在反向代理之後，請在 Z-Push 設定 USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER，否則記錄裡的位址全都是代理的。

刻意不做：ActiveSync 的 LOGAUTHFAIL 行與被拒請求的致命例外只記錄不計數，因為請求摘要已經計過該請求；單一帳號規則不提供主動回應，它的位址常是手機的電信 NAT 位址，大量位址的規則也不提供，因為封鎖最後一個位址沒有用；宣告新裝置的那一行沒有位址（緊接著的請求摘要有）；成功的請求不單以位址分級，否則行動網路上的手機每個請求都會告警；瀏覽器的 user agent 不分級（噴灑工具會用，但合法的程式也可能用，而且沒有實測資料）；沒有 user agent 允許清單，因為工具對每個帳號一輩子只告警一次；也沒有依記錄裡的 Z-Push 版本告警，因為 CVE-2025-8264（2.7.6 修正）需要 IMAP 後端加上 IMAP_FROM_SQL_QUERY，而記錄看不出來。

在 Z-Push 記錄裡的攻擊工具：這台 manager 第一次看到某帳號被腳本或攻擊工具使用時為 level 6（Z-Push 在每個例外之前與每個 GET 請求都會記錄 user agent，EASSniper 就是用 GET 試密碼），同一組合之後的請求為 level 2，所以監控腳本或用 curl 測試的管理者只會告警一次。搜尋文件庫（PEAS 用這個方式探測檔案分享，手機不會這樣做）為 level 8，只限會記錄它的後端（Zimbra 後端接受這種搜尋、回傳空結果，不會記錄）。登入名稱或帳號名稱長得像注入攻擊（引號後接 SQL 語法、LDAP 過濾語法、「../」、「${」、反引號、HTML 標籤；CVE-2025-8264 就是透過登入名稱的 SQL 注入），請求以錯誤結束時為 level 8，成功時為 level 12；被拒的仍算一次登入失敗，這樣就不能用奇怪的帳號名稱把猜密碼藏起來、躲過暴力破解規則。Z-Push 不過濾登入名稱，解碼器從行尾讀取位址與 HTTP 結果：到 1.1 為止，帳號名稱可以夾帶 from='<任意位址>'，讓那個位址被解碼出來，並被主動回應封鎖。

以 Wazuh 4.14.7 沙箱跑 147 個案例測試：例行記錄、一次郵件伺服器重啟與 user agent 是 Z-Push 2.7.6（Zimbra 後端 revision 75）的真實記錄；登入被拒、各種拒絕、遠端抹除、新裝置與攻擊工具，是依 Z-Push 2.7.6、Zimbra 後端、PEAS 與 EASSniper 的原始碼建構的，因為現有九天的記錄裡一次都沒有發生。wazuh-logtest 不套用 ignore=，所以「最多每 N 分鐘一次」的限制在那裡觀察不到；首次出現的組合則可以（logtest 依工作階段保存）。agent 群組的過濾與合併行，是用沙箱本身的記錄收集程式驗證的。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: zpush
agent_group.description: Z-Push's own log files (z-push.log, autodiscover.log), filtered on the agent and with the split request summary joined

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Make the Z-Push log reach the manager, once
setup.title_zh: 讓 Z-Push 記錄送到 manager，而且只送一份
setup.body: Z-Push writes its own files (default /var/log/z-push/, LOGFILEDIR in config.php) and nothing reaches Wazuh until something reads them. Usually: assign the host to the zpush group, which reads z-push.log and autodiscover.log, joins the request summary that Z-Push splits in two, and drops about 90 per cent of the informational lines on the host (from 1.2 it keeps the user agent Z-Push logs before an exception, a few lines a day, except that of the check_http monitoring probe). If LOGFILEDIR is elsewhere, change the two locations in the group file. If rsyslog already copies these files into /var/log/syslog with imfile (look for the Z-Push timestamp format there), the rules read that copy as it is: do not assign the group as well, or every line arrives twice and the frequency rules count each failure twice. Assigning the group restarts nothing on the Z-Push host except the Wazuh agent. Once the log arrives, expect one first-seen alert (132260 or 132261, level 3 or 5) for every account and device already in use; after that only new pairs alert.
setup.body_zh: Z-Push 寫的是自己的檔案（預設 /var/log/z-push/，即 config.php 的 LOGFILEDIR），沒有東西去讀就不會送到 Wazuh。一般做法：把主機加入 zpush 群組，它會讀 z-push.log 與 autodiscover.log、把 Z-Push 拆成兩行的請求摘要合併回來，並在主機上就丟掉約九成的資訊行（1.2 起保留 Z-Push 在例外之前記錄的 user agent，每天只有幾行，check_http 監控探測的除外）。若 LOGFILEDIR 在別處，請修改群組檔裡的兩個位置。若 rsyslog 已經用 imfile 把這些檔案複製進 /var/log/syslog（在那裡可看到 Z-Push 的時間格式），規則會直接讀那份：此時不要再加入群組，否則每一行都會送兩次，頻率規則也會把每次失敗算兩次。加入群組時，Z-Push 主機上只有 Wazuh agent 會重啟。記錄開始送達後，每個已在使用中的帳號與裝置都會產生一筆首次出現的告警（132260 或 132261，level 3 或 5）；之後只有新的組合才會告警。
setup.code:
grep -c ' \[ INFO\] ' /var/log/syslog    # on the Z-Push host: non-zero means rsyslog already copies the log
/var/ossec/bin/agent_groups -a -i <agent_id> -g zpush
/var/ossec/bin/agent_control -R -u <agent_id>
setup.verify: From any client: curl -sk -u nosuchuser:wrong -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0001&DeviceType=test' — expect rule 132210 (level 5) naming nosuchuser and your address.
setup.verify_zh: 從任一台用戶端執行：curl -sk -u nosuchuser:wrong -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0001&DeviceType=test' —— 應出現規則 132210（level 5），內容含 nosuchuser 與你的位址。

setup.title: Log the address of failed autodiscover logins (Zimbra backend)
setup.title_zh: 記錄 autodiscover 登入失敗的位址（Zimbra 後端）
setup.body: With the Zimbra backend a failed autodiscover login leaves no address in the log unless LOGAUTHFAIL is on in the autodiscover configuration (autodiscover/config.php under the Z-Push directory). Set it there only: in the main config.php it adds a second line for every failed ActiveSync login, which the pack records but does not need. PHP reads the file on every request, nothing restarts.
setup.body_zh: 使用 Zimbra 後端時，除非在 autodiscover 的設定（Z-Push 目錄下的 autodiscover/config.php）開啟 LOGAUTHFAIL，否則 autodiscover 登入失敗不會在記錄留下位址。只在那裡開啟：在主設定 config.php 開啟的話，每次 ActiveSync 登入失敗都會多一行，套件會記錄但用不到。PHP 每個請求都會重讀設定檔，不需要重啟任何服務。

setup.title: List addresses that must never be blocked
setup.title_zh: 列出絕不可封鎖的位址
setup.body: Spraying from an address in etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses raises 132216 or 132219 instead of 132215 or 132218, at the same level, and no active response is attached to those. The list ships with the private and carrier-grade NAT ranges, so that a reverse proxy or a NAT gateway that hides the client addresses is never blocked. Add your own egress addresses and proxies; keys are an address or a prefix ending in a dot. The list is yours: updates and removal of the pack leave it alone.
setup.body_zh: 來自 etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses 所列位址的噴灑，觸發的是 132216 或 132219 而不是 132215 或 132218，等級相同，且這兩條沒有掛主動回應。清單預設包含私有網段與電信級 NAT 網段，讓隱藏了用戶端位址的反向代理或 NAT 閘道永遠不會被封鎖。請加入自己的對外位址與代理；鍵值是位址或以點結尾的前綴。這份清單屬於站台：更新或移除套件都不會動它。

setup.title: Behind a reverse proxy, log the client address
setup.title_zh: 在反向代理之後，記錄用戶端的位址
setup.body: If the phones reach Z-Push through a reverse proxy, Z-Push logs the proxy's address for every request unless USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER names the header the proxy sets. Only set it when the proxy overwrites that header, or a client can choose its own logged address. A firewall block on the Z-Push host then has no effect (the connection comes from the proxy): block on the proxy instead.
setup.body_zh: 若手機經由反向代理連到 Z-Push，除非 USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER 指定了代理設定的標頭，否則 Z-Push 每個請求記錄的都是代理的位址。只有在代理會覆寫該標頭時才設定，否則用戶端可以自己決定被記錄的位址。此時在 Z-Push 主機上的防火牆封鎖沒有效果（連線來自代理）：請改在代理上封鎖。

setup.title: Optional: collect the web server access log
setup.title_zh: 選用：收集網頁伺服器的存取記錄
setup.body: Rules 132280 to 132282 read the access log of the web server in front of Z-Push: the user agent of every request is only there (Z-Push logs it only before an exception). If another group already collects that file, or rsyslog copies it into /var/log/syslog, nothing is needed. Otherwise add a localfile for it to the zpush group or to the host. The built-in web-accesslog decoder reads the Apache and nginx combined format; with another format the rules do not apply. Only the Wazuh agent restarts.
setup.body_zh: 規則 132280 到 132282 讀的是 Z-Push 前面那台網頁伺服器的存取記錄：每個請求的 user agent 只有那裡有（Z-Push 只在例外之前記錄）。若別的群組已經收這個檔案，或 rsyslog 已把它複製進 /var/log/syslog，就不必做任何事。否則請在 zpush 群組或該主機加一個 localfile。內建的 web-accesslog 解碼器讀的是 Apache 與 nginx 的 combined 格式；其他格式時這幾條規則不會套用。只有 Wazuh agent 會重啟。
setup.verify: From any client: curl -sk -A python-requests/2.31 -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0002&DeviceType=test' - expect rule 132281 (level 8) with your address.
setup.verify_zh: 從任一台用戶端執行：curl -sk -A python-requests/2.31 -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0002&DeviceType=test' —— 應出現規則 132281（level 8），內容含你的位址。

setup.title: grommunio-sync instead of Z-Push
setup.title_zh: 使用 grommunio-sync 而不是 Z-Push
setup.body: grommunio-sync, the maintained fork of Z-Push, writes the same log format and the same request summary (its lib/log/filelog.php and index.php), to /var/log/grommunio-sync/grommunio-sync.log by default (LOGFILE in its configuration). Change the first location in the group file to that path; if the host has no Z-Push autodiscover.log, remove the second entry. One difference: when the login and the mailbox differ, grommunio-sync writes [mailbox#login], Z-Push [login#mailbox], so the decoded account is the mailbox there. Checked against the grommunio-sync source, not against a running installation.
setup.body_zh: grommunio-sync 是持續維護的 Z-Push 分支，記錄格式與請求摘要相同（見它的 lib/log/filelog.php 與 index.php），預設寫到 /var/log/grommunio-sync/grommunio-sync.log（設定裡的 LOGFILE）。請把群組檔的第一個位置改成這個路徑；主機上若沒有 Z-Push 的 autodiscover.log，請刪掉第二段。唯一的差別：登入帳號與信箱不同時，grommunio-sync 寫成 [信箱#登入帳號]，Z-Push 則是 [登入帳號#信箱]，所以在 grommunio-sync 上解碼出來的帳號是信箱。這是依 grommunio-sync 的原始碼確認的，沒有在實際運作的安裝上測過。

active_response.title: Block an address that tries passwords on many accounts
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖對多個帳號試密碼的位址
active_response.body: After rejected logins for eight different accounts from one address within ten minutes (ActiveSync 132215, autodiscover 132218), drops that address on the Z-Push host for 30 minutes with iptables or nftables. Refusals of the mail server that are not a wrong password (expired token, ActiveSync off, second factor, Z-Push not in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs) are not counted, and the address is the one Z-Push logged for the connection, not one an account name can write (fixed in 1.2). Addresses in etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses (private and carrier-grade NAT ranges by default) raise other rules and are never blocked. Risks: a mobile carrier's NAT address is shared by many subscribers, and two of your users with stale passwords behind the same one look like spraying after about seven failures each; blocking it cuts off every user of that carrier gateway for 30 minutes, including users who did nothing wrong. Behind a reverse proxy the block does nothing on the Z-Push host, because the connection comes from the proxy. Deliberately not offered for one account failing repeatedly (132214): that is usually a phone with a stale password.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址十分鐘內有八個不同帳號登入被拒後（ActiveSync 132215、autodiscover 132218），在 Z-Push 主機上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址 30 分鐘。郵件伺服器不是因為密碼錯誤的拒絕（token 過期、關閉 ActiveSync、第二因素、Z-Push 不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs）不計數，封鎖的位址是 Z-Push 為這個連線記錄的位址，帳號名稱寫不進去（1.2 修正）。etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses 所列的位址（預設為私有網段與電信級 NAT 網段）觸發的是其他規則，永遠不會被封鎖。風險：電信業者的 NAT 位址由許多門號共用，你的兩位使用者若存著過期密碼又剛好在同一個 NAT 位址後面，各失敗約七次後看起來就像噴灑；封鎖會讓該電信閘道後的所有使用者 30 分鐘內無法同步，包括沒做錯事的人。在反向代理之後，Z-Push 主機上的封鎖沒有作用，因為連線來自代理。刻意不為「單一帳號一再失敗」（132214）提供：那通常是存著過期密碼的手機。
